data_source: Sample data (synthetic prices for preview, not real SPY)
assumptions: Long only: strategies are either fully invested in SPY or in cash.
Signals use the daily close; trades fill at the next day's open.
No commissions or slippage (fills at the mid between bid and ask).
Prices are adjusted for splits and dividends.

rules.buy: Buy on the first day of the period
RSI(2) below 10 while close is above 200-day SMA
MACD(12,26) line crosses above its 9-day signal line
rules.sell: MACD line crosses below the signal line

rules.buy: Close below lower band (20-day, 2 std. dev.)
Close above upper band (20-day, 2 std. dev.)
